description: Repository class for managing global watchlist entries, including methods for finding, creating, updating, and deleting watchlist items, specifically for system-wide blocking rules.

classes.name: GlobalWatchlistRepository
classes.description: Implements global watchlist operations for system-wide blocking rules, providing methods to find, create, update, and delete watchlist entries.

methods.name: findBlockedEmail
methods.description: Finds a blocked email in the global watchlist.

methods.name: findBlockedDomain
methods.description: Finds a blocked domain in the global watchlist.

methods.name: findFreeEmailDomain
methods.description: Finds a free email domain in the global watchlist based on policy.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a watchlist entry by its ID.

methods.name: listBlockedEntries
methods.description: Lists all global blocked watchlist entries.

methods.name: findBlockingEntriesForEmailsAndDomains
methods.description: Bulk retrieves blocking entries for multiple emails and domains.

methods.name: createEntry
methods.description: Creates a new global watchlist entry.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing watchlist entry by ID.

methods.name: deleteEntry
methods.description: Deletes a watchlist entry by ID.
